verdicts.reason: A: the image-left/text-right split works for a banner, but the date box is indented and not aligned with the headline's left edge. The 'EXHIBITION' kicker has dropped below the venue line, so the reading order is reversed. The logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B: the headline is bold and dominant, but it nearly butts against a narrowly cropped image that loses the original's architecture. The date box floats in the top right with illegible micro-text ('Tuesday to Sunday…'). The logo, venue and 'EXHIBITION' are jammed into one tiny run along the bottom, so the hierarchy and grouping fall apart.
